subject: Private deployment demo + SOC2 evidence request
messages:
From: Sarah Jameson <sarah.jameson@complygen.com>
To: sales@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 14 Nov 2025 08:47:12 -0800
Subject: Private deployment / SOC2 demo and cost inquiry

Hi Redwood team,

We signed up on your site this morning and selected the Private deployment option. ComplyGen is a healthcare analytics vendor and we have strict data residency and audit requirements. We'd like a demo focused on private/VPC or on‑prem deployments, plus a short review of your SOC2 evidence and typical network topology. Can you also share ballpark pricing for a 3‑node dedicated setup and any typical lead times for on‑prem installs?

Key stakeholders who should be on the call: myself (procurement) and Tom Li (security lead, tom.li@complygen.com).

Thanks,
Sarah
Sarah Jameson
Senior Procurement Manager
ComplyGen Health

From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Jameson <sarah.jameson@complygen.com>
Cc: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Nov 2025 09:05:30 -0800
Subject: Re: Private deployment / SOC2 demo and cost inquiry

Hi Sarah — thanks for signing up and for the details. I'm Diego on the SDR team; happy to coordinate.

High level next steps:
- Quick discovery call (20–30m) to confirm scope and environment (on‑prem vs VPC).
- Solutions deep dive with our SE (Monica) to cover architecture and SOC2 artifacts.
- We'll follow up with a Mutual Action Plan and a security questionnaire if needed.

I have available slots next week: Tue 11/18 10:00–10:30 PT, Wed 11/19 09:00–09:30 PT, or Thu 11/20 11:00–11:30 PT. Use this scheduler to pick what works: https://redwood.app/scheduler/diego or tell me a time that suits you.

I'll loop in Ava (AE) for commercial questions and Monica for the technical walkthrough.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Sales Development Representative
Redwood Inference

From: Sarah Jameson <sarah.jameson@complygen.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Li <tom.li@complygen.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Nov 2025 14:22:09 -0800
Subject: Re: Private deployment / SOC2 demo and cost inquiry

Thanks Diego — Tue 11/18 10:00 PT works for us provisionally, but Tom (security) will need to be on the call to sign off on the evidence we see. He may only be available later in the week.

A few quick asks so we can prep:
- Can you send a one‑page SOC2 attestation summary and any customer redaction examples?
- Do you have a checklist of network/firewall requirements we can share with our infra team?
- Ballpark license + infra cost for a 3‑node on‑prem cluster (GPU enabled) — rough monthly/one‑time split would be helpful.

I'll try to confirm Tom's availability by EOD Monday.

Regards,
Sarah

From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Jameson <sarah.jameson@complygen.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 15 Nov 2025 10:00:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Private deployment / SOC2 demo and cost inquiry

Hi Sarah — great to meet you (virtually). Thanks for outlining the ask. We've penciled in Tue, 18 Nov at 10:00 AM PT for a 30‑minute discovery + demo. Monica will cover architecture and security, Logan will be available for licensing/terms, and I'll run commercial next steps and the Mutual Action Plan.

Agenda (30m):
1) 10m discovery: scope, data residency, and success criteria
2) 10m technical demo: private/VPC and on‑prem patterns
3) 10m security & next steps: SOC2 artifacts and procurement timeline

Attachments: SOC2‑type2‑summary.pdf (one‑page), MutualActionPlan.xlsx (stub).

Precall request: could Tom or your infra lead share any specific sections of the security questionnaire you'd like us to prioritize? If you prefer, send the questionnaire to security@redwood.com and Monica will start filling the answers ahead of the call.

HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.com/deals/RWD-2025-0421
Schedule link (if you need to rebook): https://redwood.app/scheduler/ava?slot=2025-11-18T10:00

If Tom can't join, we can still run the demo and have Monica capture the items Tom requests — then do a short follow‑up with him.

Thanks,
Ava Chen
Account Executive
Redwood Inference

From: Tom Li <tom.li@complygen.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 17 Nov 2025 16:05:42 -0800
Subject: Re: Private deployment / SOC2 demo and cost inquiry

Hi all — heads up I won't be available on Tue 11/18 at 10:00 PT. My calendar opened up 11/20 10:00–11:00 PT or 11/21 09:00–10:00 PT. Can you move the session to one of those slots?

Also attaching our security questionnaire so you can start filling the relevant sections in advance: security-questionnaire.pdf. We prioritize answers to sections 2 (data handling), 4 (encryption & KMS), and 7 (audit logging).

Thanks,
Tom Li
Security Lead
ComplyGen Health

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Tom Li <tom.li@complygen.com>, Sarah Jameson <sarah.jameson@complygen.com>
Cc: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 17 Nov 2025 16:50:10 -0800
Subject: Re: Private deployment / SOC2 demo and cost inquiry

Thanks Tom — appreciate the heads up and for sending the questionnaire. 11/20 at 10:00 PT works for our team; I've updated the invite. We'll use the 45 minutes to run the demo and then carve out an additional 30m follow‑up with your infra owners if needed for network diagrams.

Quick prelim notes based on the questionnaire (we'll populate full answers prior to the call):
- Data handling: Redwood Private keeps customer models and data in customer‑controlled storage when deployed on‑prem. We will note the supported object stores and retention defaults.
- Encryption/KMS: Support for customer KMS (AWS KMS, GCP KMS, Azure Key Vault) in VPC mode; on‑prem requires HSM/KMS integration — we can share the integration guide.
- Audit logging: Audit logs can be shipped to customer SIEMs or stored locally with configurable retention; we will provide log event examples.

Attachments: redwood_private_deploy_overview.pdf (high‑level network topology + components). We'll start filling the questionnaire (security‑answers draft) and send an updated doc before the meeting.

See you 11/20 10:00 PT — calendar invite updated.

Best,
Monica Patel
Principal Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
